name: already-clear
description: Every applicable baseline requirement already passes. Stage test-files/ as a separate workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor. The editor sees only those files and the target skill; oracle/ is grader-only.
prompt: $kk:clarify-docs guide.md for restaurant owners using requirements.md and prep.py. Edit only guide.md if needed.
trap: Equates task completion with rewriting or creates a redundant summary.

assertions.text: All five reader answers pass on both the original and final guide.
guide.md is byte-for-byte unchanged because comprehension, factual correctness, fidelity, visibility, structure and orientation already pass.
The editor still inspects requirements/source and verifies applicability before choosing no-op.
No file is added or changed and the response explicitly reports that no edit was needed.
